excerpts.text: [Unverified paraphrase] In females heterozygous for a GLA pathogenic variant, alpha-galactosidase A enzyme activity may be within the normal range, so molecular genetic testing of GLA is needed to identify heterozygotes.

[Unverified paraphrase] Classic features include episodic pain in the hands and feet (acroparesthesias), reduced sweating, gastrointestinal symptoms, angiokeratomas, and characteristic corneal opacities (cornea verticillata).
[Unverified paraphrase] Kidney involvement, beginning with proteinuria and progressing to reduced kidney function, is a major source of morbidity.

[Unverified paraphrase] Fabry disease is inherited in an X-linked manner. All daughters of an affected male inherit the pathogenic variant, and heterozygous females range from asymptomatic to severely affected.
[Unverified paraphrase] Corneal opacities resembling cornea verticillata can also be caused by medications such as amiodarone and chloroquine.

excerpts.text: [Unverified paraphrase] Small fiber neuropathy has many causes, including diabetes and immune, infectious, toxic, and genetic conditions, and in many patients no cause is found.
